description: This Java class defines a custom toolbar component for the ECUEditor within the RomRaider project, providing buttons for uploading, downloading, and burning ECU images to a controller.

classes.name: ECUEditorToolBar
classes.description: A Swing toolbar component for ECU editing functions, featuring buttons for uploading, downloading, and burning ECU images.
